summary: Verified the 'Ma position' (geolocate-btn) bug fix on MapApp.js. All three geolocation scenarios pass end-to-end via Playwright with context.grant_permissions + context.set_geolocation. Regression on map load/clustering, carrier filter, and search also passes.

geo_granted_in_france_paris.expected: flyTo Paris, success toast 'Position détectée — points relais triés par distance', points re-sorted with km badge
geo_granted_in_france_paris.actual: Map flew to Paris (visible in screenshot). Success toast 'Position détectée' shown. Points re-fetched sorted by distance: nearest = 'Boulangerie - UPS, 75001 Paris' at 0.25 km. km badges rendered on PointCards. 2220 points still available in state.

geo_granted_out_of_france_london.expected: Error toast about 'hors de France', no crash, spinner stops
geo_granted_out_of_france_london.actual: 'hors de France' toast present, no km badge added (userLoc correctly not set), geolocate button spinner cleared. flyTarget reset to France center (46.6, 2.4).

geo_permission_denied.expected: Error toast about permission/autorisez, spinner stops
geo_permission_denied.actual: Denied toast present (message includes 'refusé' and 'Autorisez'), spinner cleared on the geolocate button.

regression_map_and_filters.clustering: Leaflet marker cluster visible on zoomed-out map (single '62' cluster in Rhône-Alpes for Lyon search).

critical_code_review_comments: geolocate() in MapApp.js correctly handles: unsupported browser, insecure context, granted+in-France, granted+out-of-France (with flyTarget reset), denied (PERMISSION_DENIED), unavailable, timeout. Loading state cleared in all branches. Good.
France bounds hardcoded (41-51.5 lat, -5.8-9.8 lng) — matches MapView maxBounds. Consistent.
fetchPoints re-runs when userLoc changes (dependency on useCallback) so distance sort triggers automatically. Good.
Minor (pre-existing from iteration 1): Panel duplicated across desktop/mobile causing duplicate data-testids. Not related to this fix.
test_credentials: Not required for geolocation testing. Admin: admin@relaispoint.fr / admin123 available if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geolocation must be exercised via Playwright's context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=PUBLIC_URL) + context.set_geolocation({latitude, longitude}) BEFORE page.goto. To test PERMISSION_DENIED, call context.clear_permissions() and reload. Toasts (sonner) render in document.body — verify via body.innerText contains 'Position détectée' / 'hors de France' / 'refusé'/'Autorisez'. Distance km badge rendered by PointCard when point.distance != null (backend adds this field only when lat/lng query params sent to /api/points).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (per problem statement) was that geolocate handler did not properly recenter/re-fetch. E1's fix in MapApp.js sets both setUserLoc(loc) (triggers /api/points re-fetch with lat/lng → distance-sorted) and setFlyTarget({...loc, zoom:13}) (triggers MapView FlyController to flyTo). Success toast fires only on in-France coords. Out-of-France path resets flyTarget to France center (46.6, 2.4, zoom 6) and skips setUserLoc so distance sort is not triggered. Denied/error paths always clear locating spinner. Verified working.
